short_description:
GTA 6 map secrets: Rockstar's official Leonida map has three Spanish place names with real meanings. Balsero (north of the airport) means 'rafter', the word used for the Cubans who crossed to Florida on rafts in 1994. Riquezas Keys (next to Mile Zero Air Station) means 'riches'. Abismo Key (on the Keys highway) means 'abyss'; according to GTA Wiki it's based on Bahia Honda Key, whose Spanish name means 'deep bay'. No story spoilers.

📍 Map Spot #29 of our GTA 6 map series: every spot is in the playlist "GTA 6 Map: Where to Find It".

Map: Rockstar Games (official Leonida map). Sources: Rockstar Games, Wikipedia, Vocabulary.com, SpanishDict, GTA Wiki.

short.headline: 3 SPANISH WORDS
short.text: GTA 6's map hides three Spanish words, and they mean something.

short.headline: 1. BALSERO
short.text: One: Balsero. Spanish for rafter, like the Cubans who crossed to Florida in 1994.

short.headline: 2. RIQUEZAS KEYS
short.text: Two: Riquezas Keys. It means riches, right next to the Mile Zero air base.

short.headline: 3. ABISMO KEY
short.text: Three: Abismo Key means abyss. According to GTA Wiki, it's based on Bahia Honda.
